question: Chemicals called ______ link to form proteins.
solution:
The correct answer is__** amino acids.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Amino acids:__

 __
 
• Amino acids are molecules that combine to form proteins.
 
• It is the building block of life.
 
• The human body uses **amino acids** to make proteins to help the body break down food, grow, repair body tissue, perform many other body functions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Citric acids**__

 __
 
• Citric Acid is present in** Lime and Lemon.**
 
• It is a weak organic acid.
 
• It is present in a variety of fruits and vegetables and is one of the stronger edible acids.
 
• It is also used as a flavouring and preservative in food and beverages. 
 
 
 
• **Oxalic acids**__
 __
 
• Many leafy green plants contain oxalic acid.
 
• **Oxalate** is another name of oxalic acid. •
 
• The essential nutrients like calcium and iron are absorbed by oxalic acid.
 
• In plants and plant-based foods, the concentration of oxalic acid is low.
 
• Oxalic acid is an **organic compound.**
 
 
 
• **Nitric acids**__
 
 
• It is a highly **corrosive mineral acid.**
 
• The pure compound is colourless.
 
• It is commercially available **nitric acid has a concentration of 68% in water.**
